memos.scout:
The honest case for buying ANON now is weak. The strongest points in the brief are real: the curve looks organic (bundle share 0.44%, top-3 holders 21%, completer share 17%), there was no airdrop dump, and the last 15 minutes show heavy two-sided activity (207 buyers, 203 sellers, $40.5k volume, net flow +16 SOL). Buy pressure exceeded sell pressure in that window, and the coin is up 39.5% over it.

But the same brief shows the trend has broken. The coin is 75% below its 30-minute high and down 41% over 30 minutes, and the first two minutes after graduation were sell-heavy (sell/buy ratio 0.87) with a launch bot present. Recent net flow is positive, yet the gap from the high says most early demand has already exited. Nothing here shows demand that will hold in 30-60 minutes, and the round-trip cost of 1.4-5.1% is a meaningful hurdle against a coin that has already shown it can fall fast.

No strong case for buying exists. I would pass.

That pattern reads as early buyers exiting into fresh demand, not a recovery. Thin depth (77.6 SOL pool) means a $20 ticket could eat 1.4-5.1% in round-trip cost on a small move, and a dip in a shallow pool can slip further. The bundle share (0.44%) and top-3 share (21%) look clean, so this isn't an obvious insider-bundle rug, but the dump pattern and a 0.40 return over 15 minutes after a -41% half hour point to a bounce that fades. Base rates for organic coins 30-115 minutes post-graduation already run about -20%. Skip.
